l2l_conv: Jax, I need your help preparing for the goblin attack. What can I do with these items and skills to help defend against them?

Jax, I have a ceramic jar, a wooden jar, an iron jar, and a kerosene can full of kerosene. I can also pour kerosene into an empty jar to make an oil fire can. Do you think any of these items could be useful in defending against goblins?

Jax: The goblins are becoming restless and are stepping up their attacks. We must be prepared to defeat them and keep the people safe. We know that goblins fear sudden changes in temperature; if we can use both ice and fire attacks at the same time, then we should be able to repel any attacks.
